_about: Every URL a ROLLOUT-1 block assigns (amendment A5), read by scripts/links.py: a link to a promised URL that does not exist yet renders as a pending link with its class fallback (a state to /states/, a metro to its state's #metros, a subtype to its hub, a hub to /asset-classes/, a case to /case-studies/), and links.py --relink switches it on the day the page lands. Every data-fsc-pending target already on the site counts as promised too. New metro and subtype slugs a builder chooses are added here from its requests (docs/rollout/int/REQUESTS.md). Built by the integrator from the saved blocks; the geo-4 and case-3 blocks, derived by FSC-NIGHT-1 on 21 October 2026, were added in the asset-4 t2 landing (DECISIONS I52).
